translation: Katika mwaka mwingine wa kanisa: chagua siku ili kuuchora.

english: The language of the page's buttons, menus and settings. The calendar's names, dates and readings stay in the church's language.
translation: Lugha ya vitufe, menyu na mipangilio ya ukurasa. Majina, tarehe na masomo ya kalenda yanabaki katika lugha ya kanisa.

english: The church year wheel: left and right arrow keys step a week, up and down a day
translation: Gurudumu la mwaka wa kanisa: mishale ya kushoto na kulia husogeza wiki moja, juu na chini siku moja

english: The settings most often changed: the year, the church, the feasts, the Bible and how the readings are shown
translation: Mipangilio inayobadilishwa mara nyingi zaidi: mwaka, kanisa, sikukuu, Biblia na jinsi masomo yanavyoonyeshwa

english: Every setting: the calendar, the kinds of reading, the searches, the artwork, the rings and colors, and making a page or editing the data
translation: Mipangilio yote: kalenda, aina za masomo, utafutaji, picha, pete na rangi, na kutengeneza ukurasa au kuhariri data

english: The year the church year begins in: Advent for most traditions, September for the Eastern Orthodox
translation: Mwaka ambao mwaka wa kanisa unaanza: katika Majilio kwa mapokeo mengi, Septemba kwa Waorthodoksi

english: Which church's calendar the wheel follows
translation: Kalenda ya kanisa lipi ambayo gurudumu linafuata

english: All: every commemoration. Festivals: the festivals and feasts (in the Roman calendar, solemnities and feasts). Principal: only the principal days (solemnities). None: the saints' days are left off.
translation: Yote: kila kumbukumbu. Sikukuu kuu: sikukuu kuu na sikukuu (katika kalenda ya Kiroma, sherehe na sikukuu). Sikukuu kuu pekee: siku kuu pekee. Hakuna: siku za watakatifu zinaachwa.

english: The translation the readings open in. Each church starts on the one it uses (ESV where it names none).
translation: Tafsiri ambayo masomo yanafunguka. Kila kanisa linaanza na lile linalotumia (ESV pasipo kutaja lolote).

english: How the day's readings are shown when there are several sets: one at a time under tabs, or all of them in columns (on the right, and across two columns when opened with more)
translation: Jinsi masomo ya siku yanavyoonyeshwa yanapokuwa na mifululizo kadhaa: mmoja kwa wakati chini ya vichupo, au yote katika safu (upande wa kulia, na katika safu mbili yanapofunguliwa kwa zaidi)

english: Which calendar the dates are reckoned in
How Easter is dated, which is a separate question from how the days are named. Left to follow the calendar, a Gregorian wheel keeps Western Easter and the other two keep the Eastern one.
translation: Jinsi tarehe ya Pasaka inavyowekwa, ambalo ni swali tofauti na jinsi siku zinavyoitwa. Ikifuata kalenda, gurudumu la Gregori linashika Pasaka ya Magharibi na mengine mawili ya Mashariki.

english: Name the one-year Sundays as the historic calendar does, from the first words of the day's Introit: Ad Te Levavi, Laetare, Quasimodo Geniti
translation: Ita Jumapili za mpangilio wa mwaka mmoja kama kalenda ya kihistoria, kwa maneno ya kwanza ya introitus ya siku: Ad Te Levavi, Laetare, Quasimodo Geniti

english: List the day's Bible readings under its name. Each kind can be left out; only the kinds this church's lectionary has are offered.
translation: Orodhesha masomo ya Biblia ya siku chini ya jina lake. Kila aina inaweza kuachwa; ni aina tu zilizo katika mpangilio wa masomo wa kanisa hili zinazotolewa.

english: The lessons of the day's own propers: its Sunday, holy day or season, and any other service its book appoints for it
translation: Masomo ya sehemu za ibada za siku yenyewe: Jumapili yake, siku takatifu au majira, na ibada nyingine yoyote ambayo kitabu chake kinaipangia

english: The lessons of a saint's day or festival, listed only while the wheel shows it (see Feasts)
translation: Masomo ya siku ya mtakatifu au sikukuu, yanayoorodheshwa tu wakati gurudumu linaionyesha (ona Sikukuu)

english: The lessons of a day the calendar does not name, kept by its date or a date rule: Ember and Rogation Days, Thanksgiving, New Year's and national days, the Saturdays before and after a feast
translation: Masomo ya siku ambayo kalenda haiitaji, kwa tarehe yake au kanuni ya tarehe: siku za kufunga na za maombi, Shukrani, Mwaka Mpya na siku za kitaifa, Jumamosi kabla na baada ya sikukuu

english: The hymnal's or prayer book's daily or weekday lectionary
translation: Mpangilio wa masomo wa kila siku au wa siku za kazi wa kitabu cha nyimbo au kitabu cha sala

english: The additional readings a daily lectionary offers beside its own, for reading more of the Bible (Lutheran Service Book prints them in italics)
translation: Masomo ya ziada ambayo mpangilio wa kila siku unatoa kando ya yake, ili kusoma zaidi Biblia (Lutheran Service Book inayachapisha kwa herufi za mlalo)

english: A table of psalms for daily prayer, morning and evening, by season and weekday (Lutheran Service Book, p. 304)
translation: Jedwali la zaburi kwa sala ya kila siku, asubuhi na jioni, kwa majira na siku ya wiki (Lutheran Service Book, uk. 304)

english: A plan of daily Bible reading kept by the calendar year: Reading the Word of God (LCMS, LCC and NALC), through the Old Testament in three years and the Psalms and New Testament twice
translation: Mpango wa kusoma Biblia kila siku kwa mwaka wa kalenda: Reading the Word of God (LCMS, LCC na NALC), Agano la Kale katika miaka mitatu na Zaburi na Agano Jipya mara mbili

english: The lessons of the Office: Morning and Evening Prayer, Matins, a second or third service
translation: Masomo ya sala za saa: sala ya asubuhi na ya jioni, sala ya alfajiri, ibada ya pili au ya tatu

english: Where a reading opens. On a phone or tablet either one opens in its own app when the app is installed, and in the browser otherwise.
translation: Mahali somo linapofunguka. Kwenye simu au kishikwambi kila moja hufunguka katika programu yake ikiwa imesakinishwa, na kwenye kivinjari vinginevyo.

english: How fast the sets slide between the columns when more or less is clicked (kept in this browser)
translation: Jinsi mifululizo inavyoteleza kwa haraka kati ya safu unapobofya zaidi au punguza (huhifadhiwa katika kivinjari hiki)

english: The parts of the service the church lists with each day's readings (an Introit, a Gradual and a Verse), on a line of their own after them; a set's heading opens only its readings together
translation: Sehemu za ibada ambazo kanisa linaorodhesha pamoja na masomo ya kila siku (introitus, gradual na mstari), kwenye mstari wake baada yake; kichwa cha mfululizo kinafungua masomo yake tu pamoja

english: A hymnal mark after each set of readings that searches Hymnary.org for the hymns on them in this church's hymnal
translation: Alama ya kitabu cha nyimbo baada ya kila mfululizo wa masomo inayotafuta kwenye Hymnary.org nyimbo kuhusu masomo hayo katika kitabu cha nyimbo cha kanisa hili

english: The hymnal Hymn search looks in, where the church has several
translation: Kitabu cha nyimbo ambacho Kutafuta nyimbo kinatafuta, pale kanisa lina vitabu kadhaa

english: A circled note after each set of readings that searches Word to Worship (wordtoworship.com) for contemporary worship songs on them
translation: Noti ndani ya duara baada ya kila mfululizo wa masomo inayotafuta kwenye Word to Worship (wordtoworship.com) nyimbo za kisasa za sifa kuhusu masomo hayo

english: The picture in the middle of the wheel. Each tradition has its own; any of them can be chosen. By season changes it with the day chosen: the wreath in Advent, the manger at Christmas, the empty tomb at Easter, and the church's own picture in the seasons that have none.
translation: Picha katikati ya gurudumu. Kila mapokeo yana yake; yoyote inaweza kuchaguliwa. «Kwa majira» huibadilisha kulingana na siku iliyochaguliwa: shada katika Majilio, hori wakati wa Krismasi, kaburi tupu wakati wa Pasaka, na picha ya kanisa lenyewe katika majira yasiyo na picha.

english: A thicker line where the year's last week meets its first, which are a year apart
translation: Mstari mnene mahali wiki ya mwisho ya mwaka inapokutana na ya kwanza, zilizo mbali kwa mwaka mmoja

english: Checked: at the end of the church year the arrow keys go on into the next year's wheel, and back into the last. Unchecked: they go round the year on the wheel, from its last week to its first. Page Up and Page Down and the ◀ ▶ buttons always go on.
translation: Imewekwa alama: mwishoni mwa mwaka wa kanisa vitufe vya mishale vinaendelea hadi gurudumu la mwaka ujao, na kurudi la uliopita. Bila alama: vinazunguka mwaka kwenye gurudumu, kutoka wiki yake ya mwisho hadi ya kwanza. Page Up, Page Down na vitufe ◀ ▶ huendelea daima.

english: The reds in the middle of the range (the LCMS, Roman and Presbyterian reds) read about as well with black text as with white. Checked: black on them.
translation: Rangi nyekundu za katikati ya kiwango (nyekundu ya LCMS, ya Kiroma na ya Kipresbiteri) zinasomeka karibu sawa kwa maandishi meusi kama kwa meupe. Imewekwa alama: meusi juu yake.

english: How to use the wheel, the calendar's notes and how long it took to draw
translation: Jinsi ya kutumia gurudumu, maelezo ya kalenda na muda uliochukuliwa kuchora

english: Who made the picture in the middle, and its license. When it is off and the license asks for credit, a small i button keeps it a click away.
translation: Aliyetengeneza picha ya katikati na leseni yake. Ikizimwa na leseni ikitaka kutajwa, kitufe kidogo cha i kinakiweka umbali wa mbofyo mmoja.

english: The colors the days and the rings are painted in, each of which can be changed for this page
translation: Rangi ambazo siku na pete zinapakwa; kila moja inaweza kubadilishwa kwa ukurasa huu

english: The colors on the wheel this year. Click a swatch to change it; the change is kept in the page's link. Text on a day stays readable: it turns black or white if it would not.
translation: Rangi kwenye gurudumu mwaka huu. Bofya sampuli ili kuibadilisha; badiliko linahifadhiwa katika kiungo cha ukurasa. Maandishi kwenye siku yanabaki yanasomeka: yanakuwa meusi au meupe yasipokuwa hivyo.

english: Put every color back to the page's own
translation: Rudisha kila rangi kwenye rangi ya ukurasa

english: Put every setting here back to what config.csv asks for, keeping the day on the wheel
translation: Rudisha kila mpangilio hapa kwenye kile ambacho config.csv inataka, ukiacha siku kwenye gurudumu

english: Copy a link that opens on this day, with these settings
translation: Nakili kiungo kinachofunguka katika siku hii, pamoja na mipangilio hii

english: Copy a line of HTML that shows this page inside a page of your own website (an iframe), opening on the day it is read, with these settings
translation: Nakili mstari wa HTML unaoonyesha ukurasa huu ndani ya ukurasa wa tovuti yako mwenyewe (iframe), ukifunguka katika siku unaposomwa, pamoja na mipangilio hii

english: Print the whole wheel on one page
translation: Chapisha gurudumu zima kwenye ukurasa mmoja

english: Download the wheel (SVG, PNG) and lists of its readings, colors and feasts, for this year or a run of years
translation: Pakua gurudumu (SVG, PNG) na orodha za masomo, rangi na sikukuu zake, kwa mwaka huu au mfululizo wa miaka

english: The wheel and its lists as they are here, with these settings: the church, calendars, feasts, readings, rings, colors and artwork.
translation: Gurudumu na orodha zake jinsi zilivyo hapa, pamoja na mipangilio hii: kanisa, kalenda, sikukuu, masomo, pete, rangi na picha.

english: Each day's readings, as the Readings boxes and the Feasts setting choose them
translation: Masomo ya kila siku, kama visanduku vya Masomo na mpangilio wa Sikukuu vinavyoyachagua

english: Each reading opens where Open in and Bible say; each set's heading opens all its readings
translation: Kila somo linafunguka mahali Fungua katika na Biblia zinaposema; kichwa cha kila mfululizo kinafungua masomo yake yote

english: The Sundays and principal days (or every day) with the color the wheel paints them
translation: Jumapili na sikukuu kuu (au kila siku) pamoja na rangi ambayo gurudumu linazipaka

english: The other colors the church allows, and the lower half's where the wheel splits a cell (in the feasts list too)
translation: Rangi nyingine ambazo kanisa linaruhusu, na ya nusu ya chini pale gurudumu linapogawa kisanduku (pia katika orodha ya sikukuu)

english: The festivals, saints' days and commemorations the Feasts setting keeps, on the days they fall
translation: Sikukuu kuu, siku za watakatifu na kumbukumbu ambazo mpangilio wa Sikukuu unashika, katika siku zinazoangukia

english: Also Christmas, Easter, Pentecost and the other principal days on dates of their own
translation: Pia Krismasi, Pasaka, Pentekoste na sikukuu kuu nyingine katika tarehe zake

english: Where to read about each, as the readout links it
translation: Mahali pa kusoma kuhusu kila moja, kama onyesho linavyokiunganisha

english: Previous day (up arrow; left arrow: a week, Shift: a month)
translation: Siku iliyotangulia (mshale wa juu; mshale wa kushoto: wiki, Shift: mwezi)

english: Next day (down arrow; right arrow: a week, Shift: a month)
translation: Siku inayofuata (mshale wa chini; mshale wa kulia: wiki, Shift: mwezi)

english: Type a Sunday's, a season's or a feast's name and pick it: the wheel goes to that day in the year shown (F)
translation: Andika jina la Jumapili, majira au sikukuu na ulichague: gurudumu linaenda kwenye siku hiyo katika mwaka unaoonyeshwa (F)

english: The chosen day's week in a list: each day's names, color and readings (W)
translation: Wiki ya siku iliyochaguliwa katika orodha: majina, rangi na masomo ya kila siku (W)

english: Print this week's days and readings, a page or two to hand round
translation: Chapisha siku na masomo ya wiki hii, ukurasa mmoja au miwili ya kugawa

english: How to use this page: every control, key and setting
translation: Jinsi ya kutumia ukurasa huu: kila kidhibiti, kitufe na mpangilio

english: Send feedback about this page: the day, church and settings on screen go with it
translation: Tuma maoni kuhusu ukurasa huu: siku, kanisa na mipangilio iliyo kwenye skrini vinaenda pamoja nayo

english: Type any year and the wheel is drawn for it. Click a cell, use the arrow keys, or pick a date.
translation: Andika mwaka wowote na gurudumu linachorwa kwa ajili yake. Bofya kisanduku, tumia vitufe vya mishale, au chagua tarehe.

english: Tap a cell, pinch to zoom, or pick a date.
translation: Gusa kisanduku, bana ili kukuza, au chagua tarehe.

english: Add a feast on this date
Add a picture of your own…
Add a reading to this set
Add a set of readings on this date
translation: Ongeza mfululizo wa masomo katika tarehe hii

english: No changes on this page yet.
translation: Bado hakuna mabadiliko kwenye ukurasa huu.

english: On the year beginning in Advent
Packed, about a third of the size

translation: Maandishi juu ya rangi za kiwango cha kati

english: The church, calendars and settings on screen now
translation: Kanisa, kalenda na mipangilio iliyo kwenye skrini sasa

english: The same page from Python; save or load these settings
translation: Ukurasa huo huo kutoka Python; hifadhi au pakia mipangilio hii

english: To paste into another page’s HTML
translation: Kwa kubandika kwenye HTML ya ukurasa mwingine

english: Periods with a color of their own
A kind needs a key of letters and numbers.
translation: Aina inahitaji ufunguo wa herufi na tarakimu.

english: A reading cannot be blank: Remove takes it away.
translation: Somo haliwezi kuwa tupu: Ondoa hulitoa.

english: Choose its kind and write the reading.
translation: Chagua aina yake na uandike somo.

english: This page cannot write this church’s tradition.csv.
translation: Ukurasa huu hauwezi kuandika tradition.csv ya kanisa hili.

english: Added: further readings join it with Add a reading.
translation: Imeongezwa: masomo mengine yanaungana kupitia “Ongeza somo”.

english: Nothing on this day comes from a file this page can write.
translation: Hakuna kitu cha siku hii kinachotoka katika faili ambayo ukurasa huu unaweza kuandika.

english: (not in a file this page can write)
translation: (haimo katika faili ambayo ukurasa huu unaweza kuandika)

english: Kept in this browser for this page. Make a page writes them into the page it makes.
translation: Yamehifadhiwa katika kivinjari hiki kwa ukurasa huu. “Tengeneza ukurasa” huyaandika katika ukurasa unaoutengeneza.

english: A .zip of the data files the changes make, laid out as the project's data folder
translation: Faili .zip ya faili za data zinazotokana na mabadiliko, zimepangwa kama folda ya data ya mradi

english: A page like this one, in one HTML file to put on a website or open from a folder: the page church_year.py makes with the same options (below). Each choice starts as the page is now.
translation: Ukurasa kama huu, katika faili moja ya HTML ya kuweka kwenye tovuti au kufungua kutoka folda: ukurasa ambao church_year.py hutengeneza kwa machaguo yale yale (hapa chini). Kila chaguo linaanza kama ukurasa ulivyo sasa.

english: Changes show on the wheel at once and are kept in this browser for this page; Make a page writes them into the page it makes.
translation: Mabadiliko yanaonekana kwenye gurudumu mara moja na yanahifadhiwa katika kivinjari hiki kwa ukurasa huu; “Tengeneza ukurasa” huyaandika katika ukurasa unaoutengeneza.

english: Copy the command, to make this page with the script or to set this window from it later
translation: Nakili amri, ili kutengeneza ukurasa huu kwa hati au kuweka dirisha hili kulingana nayo baadaye

english: Not a whole page: its contents go into your own page’s HTML. To show a page that is already on a website,
translation: Si ukurasa mzima: maudhui yake yanaingia katika HTML ya ukurasa wako mwenyewe. Ili kuonyesha ukurasa ambao tayari uko kwenye tovuti,

english: One row a year: Advent, Christmas, Ash Wednesday, Easter, Pentecost and the other movable dates, and how many Sundays after the Epiphany and Pentecost or Trinity (colors.py --overview). It has no iCalendar form, so with that format it comes as CSV.
translation: Mstari mmoja kwa mwaka: Majilio, Krismasi, Jumatano ya Majivu, Pasaka, Pentekoste na tarehe nyingine zinazohama, na Jumapili ngapi baada ya Epifania na baada ya Pentekoste au Utatu (colors.py --overview). Haina muundo wa iCalendar, kwa hiyo katika muundo huo inakuja kama CSV.

english: Save these settings as a small text file (the command), to load here again later
translation: Hifadhi mipangilio hii kama faili ndogo ya maandishi (amri), ili kuipakia hapa tena baadaye

english: Set the window from a command: paste one copied here before (or written for church_year.py)
translation: Weka dirisha kulingana na amri: bandika iliyonakiliwa hapa awali (au iliyoandikwa kwa ajili ya church_year.py)

english: Set the window from a settings file saved here before
translation: Weka dirisha kulingana na faili ya mipangilio iliyohifadhiwa hapa awali

english: What each color looks like on the wheel: its fill and the color of text on it. A color changed for this tradition only goes into its own colors.csv; one for every church into data/colors.csv.
translation: Jinsi kila rangi inavyoonekana kwenye gurudumu: kujaza kwake na rangi ya maandishi juu yake. Rangi iliyobadilishwa kwa mapokeo haya pekee inaingia katika colors.csv yake; kwa kila kanisa katika data/colors.csv.

english: blank: the day’s own readings; a feast’s name keeps them to that feast
translation: tupu: masomo ya siku yenyewe; jina la sikukuu linayabana kwa sikukuu hiyo

english: gives the data files they change, to put over the project’s own for the Python scripts.
translation: inatoa faili za data zinazobadilishwa, za kuweka juu ya zile za mradi kwa ajili ya hati za Python.

english: its key, as periods.csv names it: ADVENT
translation: ufunguo wake, kama periods.csv inavyouita: ADVENT
chini ya Shiriki ni rahisi zaidi.

english: --arrows-next-year, --arrows-same-year: whether the arrow keys go on into the next church year at the year's end, or round the year on the wheel (a box in the page's Settings changes it)
translation: --arrows-next-year, --arrows-same-year: kama vitufe vya mishale vinaendelea hadi mwaka ujao wa kanisa mwishoni mwa mwaka au vinazunguka mwaka kwenye gurudumu (kisanduku katika Mipangilio ya ukurasa kinabadilisha hili)

english: --art: the picture the page opens on. By season: the picture of the chosen day's season, and the church's own in a season without one
translation: --art: picha ambayo ukurasa unafunguka nayo. Kwa majira: picha ya majira ya siku iliyochaguliwa, na ya kanisa lenyewe katika majira yasiyo na picha

english: --drop-art: untick a picture to leave it out of the page
translation: --drop-art: ondoa alama kwenye picha ili kuiacha nje ya ukurasa

english: --fragment: no <html>, <head> or <body>, to paste into a page of your own
translation: --fragment: hakuna <html>, <head> wala <body>, kwa kubandika katika ukurasa wako mwenyewe

english: --help-link: the page the Help button opens, the user guide unless changed
translation: --help-link: ukurasa ambao kitufe cha Msaada kinafungua, mwongozo wa mtumiaji usipobadilishwa

english: --language: the language of the page's buttons, menus and settings until the reader chooses another (Settings > Language)
translation: --language: lugha ya vitufe, menyu na mipangilio ya ukurasa hadi msomaji achague nyingine (Mipangilio > Lugha)

english: --local-art: look for center.svg (or .png, .jpg ...) beside the page when it opens and offer it in the middle. Off, the page asks for no files beside it
translation: --local-art: tafuta center.svg (au .png, .jpg ...) kando ya ukurasa unapofunguka na uipendekeze katikati. Ikizimwa, ukurasa hauombi faili kando yake

english: --no-compress when off: the tables as plain JSON, about three times the size, to read in the page's source or for a browser older than 2023
translation: --no-compress ikizimwa: majedwali kama JSON tupu, karibu mara tatu kwa ukubwa, kwa kusoma katika msimbo wa ukurasa au kwa kivinjari cha zamani kuliko 2023

english: --no-download: the wheel as SVG and PNG, and its lists
translation: --no-download: gurudumu kama SVG na PNG, na orodha zake

english: --no-edit: changes to the titles, colors and readings, kept in the reader's browser, and the changed files to download
translation: --no-edit: mabadiliko ya vichwa, rangi na masomo, yaliyohifadhiwa katika kivinjari cha msomaji, na faili zilizobadilishwa za kupakua

english: --no-make-page: a page like itself, as this window makes
translation: --no-make-page: ukurasa kama wenyewe, kama dirisha hili linavyoutengeneza

english: --own-art: a picture of your own, for the churches you choose
translation: --own-art: picha yako mwenyewe, kwa makanisa unayochagua
Onyesha au ficha makanisa ya mapokeo ya {0}

english: Left with no picture of their own (add one for them below): {0}.
translation: Bila picha yao wenyewe (ongeza moja kwa ajili yao hapa chini): {0}.

english: choose this file again with Add a picture (a command names it but cannot carry it)
